mechanisms.note: Eight synchronised three-stage telescopic hydraulic rams in bores at r 6.77, phi 22.5 + 45k (stage frame, from +x towards +y), heads on the drum's foot ring (drum frame z -3.56); closed height <= 2.30; no counterweight. Ease-in-out over 8.0 s as built (SunClock.cpp:117-121); peak about 0.66 m/s. Use from the ring only (7.35 < r < 10.00, |z| < 0.40): open from 'lowered' is refused while the user stands on the dial (r <= 7.35, -0.30 < z < 0.60) with the message 'Step off the sun clock to raise it.'; close from 'raised' only with nobody inside r 7.20 or below z -0.30. Guard: raising holds while a body is on the dial; lowering reverses to raising if a body enters r < 7.20 or goes below z -0.30 (as built). Lights channel: 1 from the start of rising, 0 on landing (as built: on above 0.30 m).

The two retracting panels (upper flight's well side, top landing's back edge) rise 0 -> 0.94 m as the drum passes 1.20 -> 2.14 m of its 3.50 m (a cam with a dwell at each end, as built: offset = clamp(h - 1.20, 0, 0.94) - 0.94). Lowering, they are home before the drum comes within 1.07 m. 'time' is derived from the lift's cruise (0.94 / 0.60).
